PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Warehouse supervisor with 7 years of people leadership in high-volume distribution
centres across the GTA, and 10 years in warehousing overall. Currently supervise a
team of 20 associates and 2 lead hands on rotating day/night shifts in a 300,000 sq ft
retail DC. Daily user of Manhattan WMS (WMOS) for receiving, putaway, wave release,
cycle counts and labour reporting. Certified counterbalance and reach truck operator,
WHMIS 2015 trained, JHSC Certified Member (Part 1). Known for safe, steady shifts,
clean inventory and getting new hires productive fast.
